title: senecio tournefortii subsp. cespitosus
intro: Senecio tournefortii subsp. cespitosus, commonly known as mountain flax, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. Additionally, mountain flax is valued for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
